behaviorNote: The two former copies of amountInWords were identical except for the unreachable catch fallback: the finance-invoice copy formatted amount.toLocaleString(), the pdf copy called money(), which uses (amount || 0).toLocaleString(). The owner uses the null-safe form. The try body could not be made to throw with any input tried (negative, NaN, null, Infinity-free large values), so no observable change was found; this is reasoning plus tests, not proof for every input.
preservedQuirks: Amounts of 1e12 and above render with 'Ten Hundred Billion' style wording (international scale only); not changed.
notRun: pnpm install, pnpm typecheck, pnpm run build: no pnpm or network in this environment.
Tests that import finance-invoice.ts or invoice-pdf.ts: they need the database and PDF dependencies, which are not installed.
PDF output byte comparison before/after: not run.
diffReview: Changes are limited to moving two pure functions, one import line plus one re-export line in finance-invoice.ts, one import line and a deleted duplicate block in invoice-pdf.ts, an added ownership check in the validator, and one documentation row. No unrelated edits. A local-use check found formatInvoiceNumber is used inside finance-invoice.ts at invoice creation, so a local import was added in addition to the re-export.
limitations: Type correctness is unverified; only syntax was checked.
